entities.summary: Mykola Bychok, is a Ukrainian Greek Catholic prelate who has served as Eparch of Saints Peter and Paul of Melbourne, Australia since 2020. Pope Francis made him a cardinal on 7 December 2024, making him the youngest member of the College of Cardinals and youngest elector in the 2025 papal conclave. He is a member of the Redemptorists. Mykola Bychok was a religious figures from Ternopil (b. 1980-02-13, Ternopil). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
